text: In an independent two-state finite model, a rich signal exactly reveals truth and a constant-zero poor signal is its output garbling. Their optimal accuracies are 1 and 1/2, while the same fixed flipping rule f(z)=1-z scores 0 on the rich signal and 1/2 on the poor signal.
title: Exact fixed-judge reversal witness
